rules.accepted_credit_types: 40 Category 1 + 60 Category 2 hours, or 100 Category 1 hours. Category 1: ACCME-accredited activities; ACGME residency/US fellowship (full year = 50 h); advanced-degree study (full year = 50 h). Category 2 per AMA PRA definition (non-designated lectures, teaching, publications, self-instruction, other)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of the biennium: 20 Category 1 + 30 Category 2 (or 50 Category 1). Licensed in the second year: no CME.
rules.alternatives: A current AMA Physician's Recognition Award, or certification of meeting CME requirements of a society with reciprocity with the AMA, satisfies the 100 hours. Waiver/modification on notarized affidavit for isolated practice, incapacity or undue hardship.
rules.audit_note: Certify compliance at renewal; random audit (letters in October of odd years); audited licensees cannot renew online. Keep own CME records.
rules.notes: Physician (MD) licenses renew by January 31 of even-numbered years (period Feb 1 - Jan 31). CME counted over the two calendar years before renewal. Limited/temporary licenses renew annually with 50 hours.

rules.notes: Osteopathic physicians (DOS) are licensed by the same Hawaii Medical Board and follow the same Subchapter 5 CME rules, but renew by June 30 of even-numbered years. Rule text ties CME to the Jan 31 date, so exact DO counting window not confirmed.
